title: blueprint tier config
description: One tier of the blueprint server (WO-20261011-ceea, DEC-blueprint-server-tiers): its port, where its page lives, the label of the herdr pane that runs it, and where it takes promotions from. dev is live (it refreshes its own page from graph/ and work-orders/), uat and stable are released (they serve out_dir/current, which bin/promote.sh switches). A second repository changes these files and report/loop/config/blueprint.json and nothing else.

host.description: loopback only: the page carries the whole design and has no key

out_dir.description: relative to the repository root; gitignored
